payload.title: Data model: collapse status-variant indexes, generate Published* from draft models, fix N+1 reads
payload.description:
amplify/data/schema.ts: 40 models carry 156 global secondary indexes (Message 12, Assignment 10, Reference 9, SemanticRelation 9); Assignment has queueStatusKey, sectionStatusKey, sectionQueueStatusKey, status and assignmentTypeKey all keyed on status variants; every index is written on every insert. Six Published* models mirror the draft models field for field and lib/graphql-content-repository.ts:626-721 re-adapts draft into Published shape at runtime, so a field change is made in four places. loadEditionContentFromEdition (:345-367) issues 1 + 2N round trips per edition with unbounded Promise.all; listMergedAcrossStatuses (:599-624) paginates every status to exhaustion and fakes a numeric nextToken; amplify/functions/reader-settings/handler.ts:107 lists the whole UserIdentity table and .find()s by cognitoSub though userIdentityByCognitoSub exists; lib/reader-storage-url.ts:13 signedUrlCache is unbounded; lib/category-repository.ts has a stub loadCategorySteeringDashboard (:772), three dead sorters and ~970 lines of demo fixture in the server bundle.

Fix: grep each queryField name across lib/, src/ and amplify/functions and remove indexes with no caller; collapse status variants to one partitionKey#status GSI per model; generate Published* definitions from the draft ones with a helper that strips mutable fields and swaps auth; add an edition-scoped media query or denormalise lead media onto PublishedEditionItem and bound concurrency; query UserIdentity by index; LRU the signed-URL cache; move the demo builder to lib/newsroom-demo-dashboard.ts and delete the dead code. Needs a schema deploy; do it after the one-schema issue.

Done when: index count per model is under 8, Published shapes are derived, and an edition load issues O(1) GraphQL calls plus one per media batch.

Source: full code review of develop @ e9b1923 on 2026-10-17 (https://claude.ai/code/artifact/f01a3c9f-7fad-4df2-8a15-ac6c27cc83ed). Branch from origin/develop, name the branch after this issue, open a PR into develop, and record branch, PR link and verification in a comment here before closing.
